name: FixLabs Keyword Cannibalization
author: fixlabs

sections.description:
When several of your posts cover the same topic, Google has to guess which one to rank. Clicks and links get split, and often all of them rank lower than one strong post would. This is called keyword cannibalization, and it gets worse as a site grows.

FixLabs Keyword Cannibalization scans your posts and shows you which ones overlap, how strongly, and what to do about it.

Features

  • Overlap groups – posts about the same topic are grouped together, strongest overlap first.
  • Overlap score from 0 to 100 – based on shared topic words in titles and URLs, the same focus keyword, and the same category or tags.
  • Works with Yoast SEO and Rank Math – posts with the same focus keyword are flagged straight away.
  • Smart about wording – ignores filler words like “ultimate”, “complete guide” and “best”, and treats “game”, “games” and “gaming” as the same word.
  • Ignores your site’s common words – words used in most of your titles (like “game” on a gaming site) are skipped automatically, so series such as “Games like X” are not flagged by mistake.
  • Clear advice for each group – merge, change the focus keyword, or give each post its own angle, with a suggested post to keep.
  • “Not competing” button – hide a group you have checked so it stays hidden in future scans.
  • Automatic updates – a post is re-read when you save it.
  • Safe – it only reports. It never changes, merges or redirects your posts.
  • Lightweight and private – runs only in the admin, no external services, no tracking.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin, or search for “FixLabs Keyword Cannibalization”.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open Keyword Overlap in the admin menu. The first analysis starts automatically.
  4. Adjust the minimum score and extra words to ignore under Keyword Overlap → Settings if needed.
sections.faq:
Does it change my posts?

No. Version 1 only reports overlap. You decide what to merge, edit or redirect.

Do I need Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

No. Without them the plugin compares titles, URLs, categories and tags. With them it also compares focus keywords, which is the strongest signal.

Why are two different posts in the same group?

They share several topic words in their titles or URLs. If they really target different searches, click “Not competing” and the group stays hidden. You can also add words your site uses a lot under Settings → Extra words to ignore.

Is it slow on big sites?

Posts are read in small batches, and only posts that share at least one topic word are compared, so sites with thousands of posts stay fast.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

All its settings and stored results are removed from your database.
